Secunderabad. Notice period: 90 days.

Product-focused frontend engineer specializing in Vue-based applications, delivering user-facing features and performance improvements across consumer and enterprise web products.

Vue.js Developer, Pixelwave Studios — Nov 2025 - Present
Led development of a customer portal and an internal design system using Vue and Nuxt.js. Implemented component-driven pages improving load times by 28% through code-splitting and optimized HTML templates. Built interactive dashboards and migrated legacy JavaScript widgets to Vue components. Collaborated via Git and documented patterns in Confluence.

Frontend Developer, Medisure — Dec 2023 - Oct 2025
Delivered features for a telehealth web app using Vue and plain JavaScript, creating responsive HTML layouts for appointment flows and patient records. Reworked client-side routing with Nuxt.js for better SEO and reduced time-to-interactive by 18%. Maintained version control with Git and kept feature specs updated in Confluence.

Frontend Developer, Swiggy — Aug 2022 - Nov 2023
Worked on restaurant partner dashboards and consumer promo pages using Nuxt.js and Vue. Improved form validation and checkout UI, reducing error rates during ordering. Converted multiple legacy pages into modular Vue components, standardized HTML patterns, and enforced code reviews in Git. Captured implementation notes and runbooks in Confluence.

Skills: Vue; JavaScript; Nuxt.js; HTML; Git; Confluence

Education: BBA, Christ University
